parts.title: Part 5

extracts.title: Extract One
extracts.context: You hear two students, Nick and Gemma, talking about a student house.

questions.text: What is Gemma's main hesitation about moving into the house?

options.text: She won't have a good social life.
She won't get on with her housemates.
She might be distracted from her studies.

questions.text: How does Nick address Gemma's main concern?

options.text: He informs her of an agreement within the house.
He promises to set up a study group in the house.
He reassures her that guests are always welcome.

extracts.title: Extract Two
extracts.context: You hear a mature student talking to a student finance advisor about a student loan.

questions.text: The student has reservations about her ability to ...

options.text: secure a part-time job.
find a suitable bank account.
cover her living costs.

questions.text: The student was previously aware that she would ...

options.text: need a letter of proof from her university.
only have to start repaying her loan once she graduated.
be required to pay interest from the date she received the loan.

extracts.title: Extract Three
extracts.context: You hear a student talking to a member of the university Drama Club.

questions.text: Why is Darren hesitating to join the Drama Club?

options.text: He's worried he might get nervous on stage.
He doesn't want to over-commit himself.
He dislikes certain types of performances.

questions.text: How does Nina persuade Darren to join the club?

options.text: She points out a less obvious benefit.
She claims it will boost his confidence.
She says it's stressful but also challenging.

parts.passageContent:
Cavers explore underground places such as mines and tunnels as well as caves.

Cavers can pay as much as £20 for a suitable hard _____(32)_____.

Cavers can pay as much as £50 for the right kind of lamp, which is worn on the head.

Mike recommends buying expensive _____(33)_____ to avoid having accidents.

Caving is a sport for people of all ages and backgrounds.

Some caves in Britain are called 'places of special _____(34)_____'.
